scripts.prisma:generate: cd apps/labeling-api && npx prisma generate && cd ../api && npx prisma generate
scripts.start:all: pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @budapest/api exec nest start --watch & pnpm --filter @budapest/web exec vite & pnpm --filter @budapest/labeling-api exec nest start --watch & pnpm --filter @budapest/labeling-web exec vite --port 5174 & wait
scripts.stop:all: lsof -ti:3001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:3002 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:5174 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'All stopped'
scripts.restart:api: pnpm --filter @budapest/api stop && pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @budapest/api db:push
